paragraphs.text: Opal-Eye , Konda's Yojimbo was a Kitsune Samurai from Kamigawa who was active during the Kami War .

Opal-Eye is called a samurai yojimbo (yow-jim-bow; Japanese: 用心棒 ) which is Japanese term for “ bodyguard ” or “personal protection”. Based on his epithet, he served as one of the personal protectors of Takeshi Konda during the war. He wears a large cone hat and a red cape that opens up on the chest but covers the sides of his neck. He is presumed deceased following the end of the Kami War and Konda’s defeat, though there is no confirmation of this.
